admission.scope: Every production scratch extent and namespace allocation, including unused concurrent candidates, partial preparation, empty namespaces, live extents and detached/terminally retained nodes.
admission.classification: Captured once from platform_identity(exact_handle.id()) == Some(exact_handle), against the existing trusted memory sponsor before either factory. Later promotion cannot change either charge or refund.
admission.lifetime: Typed charge in the shared admitted node follows original allocation; explicit payload/node deallocation precedes refund. Partial cancellation disposes post-guard; inert preparation/retired/root fallback retains nodes and charges without allocator/counter entry.
remaining: allocator bookkeeping/overhead and other metadata families
sustained concurrent EL0 pressure and essential-service capacity/latency
scalar range identity, raw fixture disposal and broader factory/rollback/destructor/IRQ contexts
